# Purpose

This document provides the Technical Committee on Allocation Criteria (TCAC) of the Indian Ocean Tuna Commission (IOTC) with an overview of the data, assumptions and outputs used in the simulation of allocation criteria. It also briefly describes the Shiny application developed to run selected simulation scenarios interactively, highlighting updates made to the input parameters and application configuration since the previous version, and outlining the main options for setting up simulations and interpreting the results.
